suggestions.message: Update the parallelism description: scripts/build_mx.sh:22 now honors JOBS and defaults to four jobs; only build_deps.sh still derives parallelism from hw.ncpu.

Publication remains pending the immutable source URL/SHA, actual bottle metadata, package installation/relocation validation, and planned gpu-dev fast-forward. The current HEAD-only snapshot is consistent with the stated pre-tag workflow.

review.summary:
> 🧠 **From Hindsight memory (Component map)** — This repository distributes a patch overlay; I checked the exported patch against current source.
Reviewed all 23 changed/new root files and four nested source files. All three original findings are resolved: patch0056 exactly matches the complete nested diff and candidate e4bc27619f5e27ae74169f1454c497b7184c00b1; the install component includes threading with relative-rpath precedence; snapshot arguments use an option terminator. patch-replay-candidate.json records matching source trees across all 78 distributed patches; replay was not personally rerun. Saved fix1 dyld traces show build-tree and relocated executables loading their own threading library, and related GREEN logs record 59 passing tests. Identity, upstream 3.7/FITS metadata, MPI naming, legacy snapshots, and configured Python invocation are preserved; no math changes found. Formula code explicitly disables Metal and distinguishes HEAD identity. Active documentation retains failed legacy scientific gates and limits certification claims. Personally ran whitespace, Ruby/shell/Python syntax checks, candidate/patch comparisons, and read-only leading-dash probes confirming exit 2 without help bypass. No writes, staging, commits, publication, brew, imaging, builds, or test suites were performed.
